targets.review_note: A special-case relation is a downward path consisting only of type0 edges. A part relation follows zero or more type0 edges upward from the queried owner, then at least one type1 edge downward to the part; once descending a part edge, inheritance cannot ascend it. The unique forest path therefore reduces each query to its LCA and prefix counts of type1 edges. Heavy-path LCA uses linear storage, and the given parent<i ordering permits iterative size and depth construction without recursion. Different roots and reflexive queries are rejected explicitly.

targets.review_note: A noncrossing chosen pair splits the remaining people into independent regions of sizes a and n-2-a, giving g(n)=mex{g(a) XOR g(n-2-a)} with g(0)=g(1)=0. Compute this exact recurrence without assuming an observed period. For each Grundy value store a bitset of indices carrying it and a mirrored bitset about the current n-2. Intersecting one forward and one mirrored class determines whether a split produces their XOR; shift the mirrored classes once per n and test mex candidates. Python arbitrary-precision bitsets replace the quadratic split loop while retaining every split.
